problem: The text says the nematic layer is sandwiched between transparent ITO electrodes (two), but the figure stack lists only one electrode, placed after the liquid-crystal layer. A student may think a single electrode is enough to apply the field.
fix: Add a front ITO electrode to the stack: front polariser, colour filter, front ITO electrode, LC layer, back ITO electrode, back polariser (analyser), backlight.

problem: Liquid-crystal composites (polymer-dispersed liquid crystals) are described twice in almost the same words, once at the end of Section 1 and again at the end of Section 2. The repetition adds length without new information.
fix: Keep the fuller statement in one place, for example at the end of Section 2: 'Polymer-dispersed liquid crystals, where droplets sit in a polymer, scatter or transmit light and need no analyser; polymer-matrix composites belong to Unit 5.' Delete the other mention.
